thread:
deploy-broker: starting staged rollout: service=embed-service version=v2.3.1 -> traffic 5% -> 15% over 10m. commit=abc1234. watch SLOs: /embed p95, 5xx, kvcache-miss. alerting: critical+auto-pause enabled.
olivia: thanks — i'll keep an eye on p95 and 5xx dashboards. spawning trace for recent 502s.
sam: seeing a small 502 bump in eu-west ~2m ago. rate from canary hosts only.
morgan: logs show repeated `KVCache miss` + downstream connect-reset on GPU nodes. stacktrace snippet: `gpu_client.cc:241 connect_reset`
nina: can we pause the ramp until we understand? error budget used for embeds is at 3.1% today. not comfy to push to 15%. :eyes:
kai: propose step back to 8% and re-run smoke tests. slower ramp with tighter SLO gate.
deploy-broker: pausing further traffic increase per request from @nina — current traffic locked at 5%.
olivia: quick config check — this rollout enabled MODEL_QUANT=Q4_0 on canary nodes (we tested before but maybe interaction with kvcache). can we try Q8 as a revert?
sam: Q4_0 can increase memory pressure on some kernels; fallback to Q8 is fast. i can patch the canary env.
morgan: applying env override now to the canary pool:
```
kubectl set env deployment/embed-service MODEL_QUANT=Q8 -n canary
kubectl rollout restart deployment/embed-service -n canary
```
(small pause)
deploy-broker: noted env override + restart. will watch health endpoints and traces.
nina: initial metrics: 5xx rate dropping from 0.9% -> 0.35% in last 30s. latency p95 still borderline but trending down. error budget now ~1.2%. :relieved:
kai: sounds promising. plan: continue at 5% for another 10m, then advance to 8% if p95 < 250ms and 5xx < 0.5% within the window.
olivia: i'll update the release notes draft to call out the quantization toggle and the fallback procedure. Also adding a short checklist for next rollouts to include kvcache miss smoke.
sam: thumbs up. i'll follow up with a trace correlation for the prior 502s and open an issue if we see repeat.
morgan: if things hold at 8% we can proceed to 12% with the same gate. if not, we rollback to v2.3.0 and pin traffic to stable.
nina: thanks everyone. good triage rhythm. :thumbsup:
